author: IGN
description:
Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered reviewed by Will Borger on PC, also available on Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5, and Nintendo Switch 1 & 2.

"Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered is a delightful throwback to a bygone era of lazy weekends past that will give you back as much as you're willing to put into it. The roster isn't huge and there isn't a ton of solo combat, but this rubber suit rests atop a deceptively deep combat system, and smashing these monsters together like action figures, especially with friends, never gets old. I wish it gave you access to more of it out of the gate rather than hiding so much behind unlocks, but if you vibe with Destroy All Monsters Melee’s old school style and its gameplay is your kind of monster, there’s more than enough here to keep you happy. Sometimes the old ways are best. Go go Godzilla."
title: Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered Review

Check out this creepy deleted scene from Other Mommy, a horror film starring Jessica Chastain, Dichen Lachman (Severance), Sean Kaufman (The Summer I Turned Pretty), and Jay Duplass. Other Mommy also stars Arabella Olivia Clark, Arian Moayed, and Karen Allen.

Chastain stars in a terrifying trip into the darkening world of a young girl, Bela, who forms a relationship with a disturbing entity in her home who looks uncannily like her own mother. Other Mommy proves to be more than a mere figment of the girl’s imagination as she becomes a sinister, manipulative presence determined to tear apart Bela’s family.

Other Mommy is produced by James Wan p.g.a. Executive producers are Michael Clear Judson Scott, Josh Malerman, and Ryan Lewis. Based on a novel by Josh Malerman. The screenplay is by Nathan Elston. 

Other Mommy, directed by Rob Savage, comes to digital platforms beginning November 10, 2026, and on 4K and Blu-ray on December 29, 2026, from Universal Pictures Home Entertainment.

In How To Rob A Bank, a crew of social media-savvy bank robbers broadcasts their daring heists, unaware that their growing viral fame has put them in the crosshairs of a veteran FBI agent and a brilliant software engineer. Despite the unlikely duo closing in, the crime ring pushes past their limits, putting everything on the line for their beliefs — and their most ambitious heist yet.

How To Rob A Bank is produced by Brian Grazer, Jeb Brody, p.g.a., Allan Mandelbaum, p.g.a., Kelly McCormick, p.g.a., and David Leitch, p.g.a. Executive producers are Ben Ormand and Mark Bianculli. It is written Mark Bianculli.
